nativeFormatProfile.configuration: GTK enabled; Perl, Python, component and introspection disabled. Source-derived GSettings schemas supplied explicitly after the configure libgio lookup failed; clean native readback has no configuration warnings.

cases.currentFinding: SDK/Shell actual-cwd binding is delivered. Logical PWD aliases now require matching scoped directory identity through the public resolveVfsCwd helper, preserving exact exports and GETENV. Native GLib/GIO 2.90.0, memory-backed SDK/Shell, split/graph publication, cancellation and public-consumer checks cover the qualified POSIX behavior. Native Windows, broader real-adapter/installed-package qualification and containing publication remain open.

WK1/WK3 names, WK3 coordinates, function names and namespace lifecycle repairs are implemented. WK3 op7/op8 external-variable fallback now preserves cell/range identities and relative axes after defined-name lookup; malformed names retain diagnostics and recalculation requires the explicit external-reference host. Full package suite: 403 files / 23,430 tests; 24 compiled SDK/Shell XML/XLSX conversion/readback profiles passed. Native Gnumeric 1.12.61 accepts the constant control but misparses the named token, so native parity is not claimed. Independent application readback, dynamic/relative-sheet identity and wider profiles remain open.

Qualified external-name binding, macro identity, duplicate replacement, permanent names and global alias spelling are repaired. Formula conversion and sheet edits preserve quoted external-workbook identities, including raw external named expressions, without adding implicit resolution authority. Legacy relative rows now wrap at 16,384; BIFF8 keeps 65,536. Final-row named references recalculate to 42 in native Gnumeric and compiled SDK/Shell readback; 858 BIFF tests pass. Wider token/version/reference semantics, dynamic diagnostics and final qualification remain open.

Explicit host passwords support XOR, standard RC4 and CryptoAPI imports and exports. Independent XOR decryption matches 152 streams from 114 SDK exports; msoffcrypto reads all 76 BIFF8/DSF primary streams. Native Gnumeric now reads 12 XOR and four standard-RC4 exports exactly, including continued strings and formula recalculation, and rejects 13 wrong-password controls without output. Its tested 16+ UTF-16-unit RC4 passwords and all 12 CryptoAPI profiles are refused; these are native limits, not product support restrictions. Other applications, ancillary streams/properties, additional applicable profiles and containing publication remain open.

AES-CBC, Blowfish CFB8/CFB64 and LibreOffice Argon2id/AES-GCM imports and explicit encrypted exports are implemented. LibreOffice 26.8 opens qualified AES, CFB64 and modern ASCII/Unicode-password exports. Independent crypto and SDK checks also pass modern empty passwords, which the native loader refuses. Broader algorithm/application/platform qualification and containing publication remain open.
Qualified on-file-key encrypted imports match native records. Wider profiles, companions, writing and final delivery qualification remain open.
Optional port, injected clock, timezone, arity, namespace and budget controls are implemented. Complete activated native-profile qualification remains open.

Bounded substitution grammar, captures, lookbehind, classes and raw-byte results are implemented for qualified cases. Wider grammar, Unicode, diagnostics and native lifecycle/profile qualification remain open.

Bounded formatting, arrays and precision-limited reference formats are implemented. Address-bearing representations, raw reference/sheet APIs and wider language conversion remain open. Native array/range/axis controls pass; combined sheet/tuple probes crash and must not be counted as passes.

Unicode 16 capitalization, typed split errors and NUL boundaries are implemented. Unicode 15 differences, exact optional runtime profiles and wider diagnostics remain open. Native malformed-UTF8 crashes retain a portable refusal.

EXECSQL/READDBTABLE use an explicit bounded cooperative host query port. Native successful connection/query behavior, formatted/date results and full lifecycle remain unqualified; headless native connection attempts fail.

Invocation-owned datasource sessions, partial records, recalculation, rebinding and cleanup are implemented. Qualified FIFO phases pass. Native scheduling/read splitting, late feeds, broader watch lifecycles and deployment qualification remain open.
Retained Linux log1p/acos/pow controls and public numeric cohorts match exact binary64 results. Wider domains and other runtime profiles remain open.
Retained private primitives and public Bessel/numeric cohorts match the qualified Linux profile. Wider arguments, high-q behavior and other profiles remain open.

All 48 directional services have implementation owners; public listings expose 20 importers and 27 exporters. Registration is not semantic completion. Version/subformat/record preservation and independent roundtrip closure remain open.

Qualified page breaks, explicit fonts, neutral materialized styles and rounded glyph advances are implemented. Measured glyph-bound differences remain; full pixel, style, chart, merge, rich-text and overflow fidelity remains open.
Qualified linear/nonlinear models and reports match native CSV effects. Report diagnostics, independent solver factories, wider sensitivity/nonlinear/analysis behavior and layout remain open.
Eight activation environments and fourteen capability obligations remain open. Some authenticated Linux and language cohorts execute successfully; availability or registration alone is not a pass.
An isolated local packaged plugin passes typing and XLSX readback. Final packed root SDK/Shell, private-workspace independence, registry and installed-consumer qualification remain open.
